engine.notes: Columbus improv runs through two rooms a mile apart on High Street, the Nest in Old North and Hashtag in the Short North, with troupes such as Bluebird Improv and Ohio State's Fishbowl playing their stages. Columbus Funny Bone advertises occasional improv classes but blocked verification, and the Columbus Comedy Festival each late summer is a festival rather than a venue.

entries.name: The Hashtag Comedy Club
entries.summary: A comedy club and school at 1253 N High Street, grown from an improv show running more than thirteen years, with five improv levels, sketch and musical-improv workshops, a monthly house improv show, an improvised musical and touring comics.
entries.schedule: Hashtag Comedy Improv Show monthly, next October 9, November 13, December 11; Level 1 to 5 classes start late October
signals: Improv show running more than 13 years
Club of its own in the Short North since 2023
Five improv levels plus sketch and senior classes
Monthly house improv show and improvised musical
entries.reasons: A room of its own, a five-level school with October start dates and a calendar into 2027; the house improv show is monthly rather than weekly, which is the main gap.

entries.name: The Nest Theatre
entries.summary: Columbus's dedicated improv theatre since 2016, in Old North, with an improv-first class programme alongside sketch and experimental work and a stage that local press calls the center of the city's improv community.
entries.schedule: Classes and shows listed on the site's calendar
signals: Expanded its Old North space in 2024
Improv classes plus sketch and live literature
Profiled by the Columbus Dispatch, June 2025
Named in Columbus Monthly's August 2026 scene feature
entries.reasons: A decade-old improv theatre with a home of its own and consistent press through 2026, scored cautiously because its site renders no schedule to a text crawler.
